title: Home dashboard next queue panels
summary: Redesign the Home daily-use panels by replacing At A Glance with Next 5 Videos, making Run Progress visible, and keeping Recently Completed directly below progress.
reason: The old At A Glance queue preview could surface recently completed or non-runnable rows beside current progress, which was confusing for operator triage.
behavior_before: Home showed an At A Glance panel combining current item progress with a raw up-next slice, while Run Progress, Queue Snapshot, and Current Run were grouped behind the Advanced gate.
behavior_after: Home shows Next 5 Videos from queue.rows filtered to operator_status Ready or Priority ready, preserves backend queue order, caps the list at five, displays Run Progress immediately after it, and leaves Queue Snapshot plus Current Run behind Advanced.
